INSTALL: EXPTRACK-1.1.0.apk (4,189,444 bytes)

Install over your existing EXPTRACK. Keep the existing app installed to preserve its expenses.

Create an account or sign in while online. Tracking expenses works offline afterward. Sessions last 30 days; sign in online again when they expire.

Accounts are saved in MongoDB Atlas; expenses are saved on the phone. Cloud expense backup is not enabled yet.

Android 7+ and WebView/Chrome 111+ are required. An older WebView shows an update instruction after installation.
